sloka: गजो गवाक्षो गवयः शरभो गंधमादनः ।मैन्दः च द्विविदः चैव सुषेणो जांबवान् तथा ॥४-६५-२॥
transliteration: gajo gavākṣo gavayaḥ śarabho gaṁdhamādanaḥ ।maindaḥ ca dvividaḥ caiva suṣeṇo jāṁbavān tathā ॥4-65-2॥

translations.english: Thereafter, on hearing Angada, all the leaders among the monkeys, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sarabha, Gandhamadana, Mainda, Dvivida, Sushena and Jambavan as well expressed one after the other their capability for leaping.
translations.hindi: दे समस्त वानर कुलों में श्रेष्ठ हनुमान्‌ ! हे सर्वशाखूविशा- रद्‌ ! तुम अकेले और चुपचाप क्यों बैठे हो? क्यों नहीं कुछ कहते १
